methodology.framework: Normative legal hierarchy based on UU 12/2011 Articles 7-8 as amended by UU 13/2022; cross-sector delegation network and RIA-lite issue triage.
methodology.exhaustiveness: Curated high-signal illustrative register; not every Indonesian legal instrument. Confirm consolidated texts/implementing rules at time of transaction.

status_dictionary.enacted: officially enacted instrument; later changes may still require review
status_dictionary.repealed: repeal supported by successor official source
status_dictionary.amended: historical base document amended; use consolidated legal text
status_dictionary.check_current: document existence verified; current amendment/repeal status not comprehensively rechecked
status_dictionary.transition_review: transition and alignment require legal verification
status_dictionary.listed_active_review_alignment: listed active by regional JDIH, but alignment with new KEN not legally adjudicated
status_dictionary.issued_plan_not_commissioned: legal administrative RUPTL planning approval, not completed physical projects
status_dictionary.project_specific: not a single legal instrument and not automatically satisfied
status_dictionary.archival_not_verified: historical Director-General reference only; do not apply as current law

methodology.article_8_branch: Article 8 UU 12/2011: regulations by Ministers, Governors, Regents/Mayors and authorized authorities are binding insofar as ordered by superior legislation OR issued under their legal authority. They are parallel competency/delegation branches, not automatic eighth–tenth levels of Article 7. A Pergub may implement a provincial Perda; a Perbup/Perwali implements lawful authority and relevant Kabupaten/Kota Perda or national spatial rules, but DOES NOT automatically derive from or stand beneath the Pergub. Kepmen often administrative decisions, not normative regulations. Inpres is a presidential executive instruction directed at addressees; it is not Perpres and not an extra Article 7 rung. International treaty obligations and WTO rulings are a separate international-law layer; Indonesia's ratification instruments appear at their domestic form.

ria_lite.purpose: transparent qualitative prioritization of investor due diligence, not government statutory Regulatory Impact Assessment, cost-benefit CBA, actual probability, compliance finding or legal verdict.
ria_lite.scale: six analyst-assigned 1–5 ordinal issue exposure ratings; uncalibrated, scenario screening only; higher=more diligence needed, not 'illegal'.
ria_lite.score_formula: sum(weight_i*(exposure_i-1)/4)*100; normalized 0–100 as relative issue coverage signal only
ria_lite.limitations: Scores are illustrative analyst judgments; no empirical financial/likelihood calibration. Do not compare jurisdictions as objective regulatory risk. Missing compliance evidence is not a violation.

methodology.cross_ministry_implementation: Parallel regulations from BKPM/OSS, ATR/BPN, KLH/BPLH, ESDM, Kemenperin and Komdigi must be mapped by KBLI, permits and legal delegation, not mistaken for a joint regulation or one ministry's rules governing another.
methodology.international_law_notes: Treaties, investment agreements and arbitration rules differ in binding parties, forum and domestic implementation. WTO dispute DS592 is state-to-state and under appeal with a non-functioning Appellate Body in published record; ICSID is investor-state subject to consent, while New York Convention covers arbitral award recognition; UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules operate if adopted. No investor wins/loses automatically.

nodes.label: Constitutional foundation for strategic natural resources
nodes.note: Constitutional basis for state control and public welfare; not a substitute for sector permits.

nodes.label: Hierarchy category; no specific operative energy TAP is asserted
nodes.note: Pasal 7 UU 12/2011 lists TAP MPR. Placeholder category, not a claim of a sectoral rule.

nodes.label: Formation and hierarchy of legislation
nodes.note: Pasal 7 formal hierarchy; Pasal 8 recognizes other regulations if authorized. Interpret together with UU 13/2022.

nodes.label: Cipta Kerja / omnibus framework
nodes.note: Enacts Perppu 2/2022; affects licensing, environment and sector statutes. Do not use repealed UU 11/2020 as sole operative anchor.

nodes.label: Energy framework
nodes.note: Planning and governance of energy. PP 40/2025 implements national energy policy.

nodes.label: Electricity law
nodes.note: Public/private electricity supply, licensing, reliability and supervision. Consolidate with amendments before investment legal diligence.

nodes.label: Oil and natural gas framework
nodes.note: Upstream contracts and downstream licensing have different supervisory chains; read with judgments and amendments.

nodes.label: Mining baseline act
nodes.note: Original Mineral and Coal Mining statute; do not treat its 2009 text as consolidated current law.

nodes.label: Mining amendment of UU 4/2009
nodes.note: Historical amending instrument, read with later UU 2/2025.

nodes.label: Fourth amendment to mining law
nodes.note: Mining investment and concessions require the current consolidated mining framework.

nodes.label: Environmental protection framework
nodes.note: Environmental approval and compliance; read as amended by Cipta Kerja legal regime.

nodes.label: Personal Data Protection
nodes.note: Data-center investors must distinguish obligations of controllers/processors and compliance details; not an enacted AI roadmap.

nodes.label: Regional-government competency and authority
nodes.note: Defines central/regional division of authority; read with amendments and sector-specific delegations.

nodes.label: National Energy Policy (KEN)
nodes.note: Latest national policy basis; transitional provisions preserve implementing rules insofar as consistent.

nodes.label: Former national energy policy
nodes.note: Historical KEN superseded by PP 40/2025; avoid citing old mix targets as current new KEN.

nodes.label: Risk-based business licensing
nodes.note: Replaces PP 5/2021. Project KBLI, NIB, risk tier and permits need activity-level assessment.

nodes.label: Former risk-based business licensing
nodes.note: Explicitly revoked by PP 28/2025; historical reference only.

nodes.label: Electricity supply business regulation
nodes.note: Read with PP 23/2014 and later sectoral and omnibus amendments.

nodes.label: ESDM sector administration
nodes.note: Operating and electricity sector framework; ensure compatibility with PP 28/2025 licensing.

nodes.label: Environmental approval, AMDAL and UKL-UPL
nodes.note: Environmental permitting procedures and emission/water requirements; applicability depends on project characteristics.

nodes.label: Mining business implementation
nodes.note: Read with PP 25/2024 and UU 2/2025; evolving concession and processing rules.

nodes.label: Amendment to PP 96/2021
nodes.note: Amending regulation, not a standalone consolidated mining license checklist.

nodes.label: Renewable electricity acceleration
nodes.note: New and renewable electricity development; PPA guidelines are operationalized in Permen ESDM 5/2025.

nodes.label: Carbon capture and storage
nodes.note: CCS activities, permits and storage regime; separate from carbon credit eligibility.

nodes.label: Carbon economic instruments and GHG governance
nodes.note: Carbon compliance, accounting and trading exposure needs transaction-specific verification.

nodes.label: RUEN (historical national energy planning)
nodes.note: Legacy planning instrument premised on older KEN. Check applicability/transition under PP 40/2025; do not automatically call repealed.

nodes.label: RUED West Java 2018–2050
nodes.note: JDIH lists as berlaku; harmonization with national PP 40/2025 still needs substantive review.

nodes.label: RUED Central Java
nodes.note: JDIH lists as berlaku. Legacy assumptions may diverge from new national KEN.

nodes.label: RUED Riau Islands 2023–2050
nodes.note: JDIH Kepri lists as berlaku; important for Batam regional power strategies.

nodes.label: Electricity business implementation
nodes.note: Electricity business licensing and ancillary services. Sector provisions require compatibility checks against PP 28/2025.

nodes.label: Renewable power-purchase agreement guidance
nodes.note: PPA allocation of risks, commissioning/COD, guarantees, performance and environmental attributes.

nodes.label: Rooftop photovoltaic generation on licensed utility grid
nodes.note: Quota, grid access and utility requirements are installation-specific.

nodes.label: Energy management
nodes.note: Energy audits and conservation compliance; verify regulated consumer applicability and thresholds.

nodes.label: Electricity service quality and related costs amendment
nodes.note: Amends Permen ESDM 27/2017 on service quality and costs, relevant to outage/service diligence.

nodes.label: Oil & gas work-area cooperation for production
nodes.note: Regulatory instrument for upstream cooperation; specific contract impact requires review.

nodes.label: PLN RUPTL 2025–2034 approval
nodes.note: Approves 69,512 MW generation/storage, 47,758 circuit-km transmission, 107,950 MVA substations as planned additions, not realized capacity.

nodes.label: Special gas users/prices for public electricity
nodes.note: Decision designates eligible public-electricity gas users and prices; beneficiary and amendment need independent confirmation.

nodes.label: Historical electricity competence-certification supervision guide
nodes.note: Historic sample illustrating Director-General rules. Referenced earlier statutes; CURRENT ENFORCEABILITY UNVERIFIED. Not a live compliance checklist.

nodes.label: Installation and operating safety evidence
nodes.note: Technical compliance workstream, not one standalone named law. SLO criteria depend on installation class and latest implementing regulation.

nodes.label: Project-specific environment screening
nodes.note: Applicable assessment depends on project size/location and applicable threshold lists; approval is not automatically implied.

nodes.label: Project-specific risk-based license file
nodes.note: Project-by-project KBLI/OSS license, sector PB UMKU, site and tenure evidence required.

nodes.label: Firm connection, reliability and operational readiness
nodes.note: No project is verified energized from RUPTL approvals; request PLN local substation/feeder, energization dates, N-1, COD and actual contracted power.

nodes.label: DPIA, contracts, controls and incident readiness
nodes.note: Responsibility depends on controller/processor role and facts. Cybersecurity law and AI draft status assessed separately.

nodes.label: Measure, report, verify and attribute carbon claims
nodes.note: Carbon value or offset cannot be presumed solely by procurement of renewable generation or CCS equipment.

nodes.label: Establishment of Batam as industrial area (historical legal basis)
nodes.note: Historical Presidential Decision underpinning Batam industrial development and former Otorita Batam. BP Batam traces its institutional origin here; do NOT treat 1973 text as a consolidated 2026 investment or land-permit rule. Follow later FTZ and organizational legislation.

nodes.label: Penataan Ruang, termasuk perubahan Cipta Kerja
nodes.note: Pijakan legislasi RTRW, RDTR, dan kesesuaian pemanfaatan ruang; pakai teks konsolidasi terbaru.

nodes.label: Penanaman Modal
nodes.note: Dasar penanaman modal lintas sektor, beririsan dengan OSS, izin lokasi, fasilitas fiskal dan pelaporan investasi.

nodes.label: Perindustrian
nodes.note: Pengaturan kegiatan industri termasuk smelter dan kawasan industri. Periksa ketentuan perubahan dari UU Cipta Kerja.

nodes.label: Penyelenggaraan Penataan Ruang
nodes.note: Integrasi tata ruang dan izin lokasi lintas sektor. Perhatikan kewenangan pusat-daerah serta RDTR setempat.

nodes.label: Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang (KKPR)
nodes.note: JDIH ATR/BPN mencantumkan berlaku; kewajiban KKPR/PKKPR perlu dicocokkan dengan RDTR dan perubahan aturan OSS.

nodes.label: Daftar usaha wajib AMDAL, UKL-UPL atau SPPL
nodes.note: Klasifikasi kegiatan/KBLI dan ambang lingkungan memengaruhi data center, smelter dan infrastruktur listrik; cek perubahan terkini.

nodes.label: Tata cara OSS dan fasilitas penanaman modal
nodes.note: Pelaksanaan PP 28/2025 lintas kementerian termasuk syarat dasar, izin penunjang, fasilitas investasi, pengawasan dan ketentuan peralihan.

nodes.label: Standar kegiatan usaha/produk sektor industri dalam OSS
nodes.note: Implementasi PP 28/2025 untuk sektor industri termasuk persyaratan dan klasifikasi kegiatan industri; rincian KBLI bergantung entitas proyek.

nodes.label: RTRW Kabupaten Bekasi 2011–2031
nodes.note: Kerangka tata ruang tingkat kabupaten; JDIH BPK mencantumkan berlaku, tetapi sinkronisasi terhadap aturan yang lebih baru dan RDTR perlu diperiksa.

nodes.label: Petunjuk pelaksanaan RUED Jawa Tengah
nodes.note: Peraturan Gubernur ini secara eksplisit menjalankan Perda Jateng 12/2018 tentang RUED. Status tercatat berlaku; harmonisasi dengan KEN 2025 perlu ditelaah.

nodes.label: RDTR Kawasan Perkotaan Cikarang Bekasi Laut 2024–2044
nodes.note: Peraturan Bupati menetapkan struktur dan pola ruang serta zonasi daerah tertentu, bukan izin proyek data center otomatis. JDIH BPK mencantumkan berlaku.

nodes.label: RDTR Kecamatan Tugu 2023–2043
nodes.note: Contoh Peraturan Wali Kota yang menetapkan RDTR pada yurisdiksi kota sendiri; bukan aturan pelaksanaan Pergub Jawa Tengah secara otomatis.

nodes.label: Site-specific land zoning compliance
nodes.note: Pemeriksaan peta bidang, zonasi, persyaratan dasar OSS, Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang dan perizinan berusaha, khususnya lokasi data center/smelter.

nodes.label: Efisiensi belanja APBN dan APBD Tahun Anggaran 2025
nodes.note: Instruksi kepada kementerian/lembaga dan kepala daerah untuk meninjau efisiensi belanja 2025. Tidak otomatis membuktikan pengurangan alokasi proyek tertentu. Status JDIH: berlaku.

nodes.label: Percepatan Kawasan Swasembada Pangan, Energi, dan Air Nasional
nodes.note: Instruksi terkoordinasi lintas kementerian/provinsi termasuk Papua Selatan, Kalimantan Tengah/Kalimantan Selatan, Sumatera Selatan. Berlaku sebagai instruksi kepada penerima, bukan izin investor atau kewajiban umum yang berdiri sendiri.

nodes.label: Penguatan Percepatan Kawasan Swasembada Pangan, Energi, Air
nodes.note: Menugaskan Menko Pangan dan Menteri ATR/BPN memperkuat implementasi Inpres 14/2025. JDIH BPK mencatat berlaku; bukan Perpres atau PP.

nodes.label: Pengesahan Agreement Establishing the WTO
nodes.note: Ratifikasi Indonesia atas Persetujuan Pembentukan WTO. Kewajiban WTO pada negara anggota berbeda dari penerapan langsung setiap ketentuan sebagai izin investor domestik.

nodes.label: Quantitative restrictions on imports/exports
nodes.note: Kewajiban WTO mengenai pembatasan kuantitatif impor/ekspor; relevan untuk pembatasan ekspor mineral dan analisis pengecualian Pasal XX/XXI. Berlaku antarnegera anggota, bukan Perpres.

nodes.label: Subsidies and Countervailing Measures
nodes.note: Disiplin subsidi dan tindakan imbalan; analisis insentif perlu pemeriksaan jenis subsidi, spesifisitas, dan kontinjensi ekspor/lokal.

nodes.label: Trade-Related Investment Measures
nodes.note: Relevan untuk persyaratan konten lokal dan pembatasan perdagangan tertentu; penerapan memerlukan analisis teks per kasus.

nodes.label: General Agreement on Trade in Services
nodes.note: Perdagangan jasa cloud/IT/telekomunikasi perlu mengkaji jadwal komitmen Indonesia dan pengecualian; bukan liberalisasi otomatis seluruh sektor.

nodes.label: Dispute Settlement Understanding
nodes.note: Kerangka penyelesaian sengketa antaranggota WTO, bukan klausul arbitrase investor-swasta. Status panel, adopsi, banding dan kepatuhan harus dibedakan.

nodes.label: EU challenge to Indonesian nickel export measures
nodes.note: Panel WTO 30 Nov 2022 menyimpulkan pembatasan ekspor nikel dan persyaratan pengolahan tidak konsisten dengan GATT XI:1. Indonesia mengajukan banding 8 Des 2022 saat Appellate Body tidak berfungsi. Jangan tandai laporan panel sebagai diadopsi/final ataupun larangan nasional otomatis dicabut. Status terkini perlu dicek di laman perkara WTO.

nodes.label: Arbitrase dan Alternatif Penyelesaian Sengketa
nodes.note: Dasar penyelesaian arbitrase komersial di Indonesia; yurisdiksi/eksekusi tergantung perjanjian, objek arbitrabilitas, putusan dan syarat hukum.

nodes.label: Prosedur pengadilan terkait arbitrase
nodes.note: Mengatur penunjukan arbiter, hak ingkar, pelaksanaan dan pembatalan putusan arbitrase di pengadilan. Status tercatat berlaku.

nodes.label: Ratifikasi Konvensi New York 1958 — foreign arbitral awards
nodes.note: Ratifikasi Konvensi Pengakuan dan Pelaksanaan Putusan Arbitrase Asing. Rezim pengakuan/eksekusi tidak menjamin otomatis semua award dieksekusi.

nodes.label: Persetujuan ICSID Convention
nodes.note: Ratifikasi Konvensi penyelesaian sengketa investasi Negara–WNI asing. Keanggotaan ICSID ≠ persetujuan arbitrase untuk semua investor/proyek.

nodes.label: Investor–State arbitration framework
nodes.note: ICSID Convention berlaku untuk Indonesia sejak 28 Oktober 1968. Yurisdiksi memerlukan persetujuan tertulis dan prasyarat terkait lain; tidak otomatis ada dari keanggotaan saja.

nodes.label: Recognition and enforcement of foreign arbitral awards
nodes.note: Indonesia mengaksesi pada 7 Oktober 1981 dan berlaku 5 Januari 1982; lihat reservasi yang berlaku dan syarat eksekusi pengadilan.

nodes.label: Model procedural arbitration rules
nodes.note: Aturan prosedur bersifat pilihan jika disepakati/digunakan di instrumen relevan; bukan UU Indonesia otomatis dan bukan lembaga arbitrase sendiri.

nodes.label: Investment agreement treaty eligibility and consent
nodes.note: Periksa treaty negara asal investor, keberlakuan, klausul perlindungan, sunset clause, nationality, seat, dan persetujuan arbitrase. Tidak semua perjanjian berlaku bagi semua investor.

nodes.label: Climate treaty / NDC commitments
nodes.note: Perjanjian iklim internasional mewajibkan tindakan negara; kewajiban spesifik proyek dibentuk melalui regulasi dan izin nasional. Jangan menyamakan NDC dengan izin emisi proyek.

nodes.label: Persetujuan Paris Agreement
nodes.note: Pengesahan Paris Agreement di Indonesia; penerapan kepada fasilitas perlu regulasi nasional dan persetujuan lingkungan.

issues.title: Multitrack OSS + electricity licensing
issues.reason: A data center project may combine zoning, business licensing, direct energy arrangements and environmental approvals.
issues.mitigation: Trace KBLI and permit issuers; request NIB, IUPTL/private supply documentation and PB UMKU where applicable.

issues.title: Energy availability vs RUPTL pipeline
issues.reason: RUPTL plan and contracted power do not prove commissioning, N-1 headroom or site-level firm power.
issues.mitigation: Require PLN/PLN Batam connection agreement, substation reservation, COD and grid study.

issues.title: Cooling/water and AMDAL
issues.reason: Cooling efficiency, water discharge and environmental approval depend on site and design.
issues.mitigation: Confirm water sourcing permits, environmental approval, effluent and cooling technology.

issues.title: Transition from PP 5 to PP 28
issues.reason: Licensing files must be reviewed under PP 28/2025, not legacy PP 5/2021.
issues.mitigation: Update OSS checklist and transition provisions by KBLI and filing date.

issues.title: PDP / cloud-service obligations
issues.reason: Cloud/data handling activates role-specific PDP compliance requirements.
issues.mitigation: Map controller/processor, DPA, security controls and transfer treatment.

issues.title: Project execution evidence
issues.reason: Investor announcements may not equal financing close, commissioned GPU fleet or active data center MW.
issues.mitigation: Verify grid energization, financing close, capacity type, commissioning and installed compute.

issues.title: Licensing and site access
issues.reason: Energy, land, spatial planning and environmental approvals intersect.
issues.mitigation: Document land rights, grid access, KBLI and environmental obligations.

issues.title: Transmission capacity & connection
issues.reason: Available network headroom and curtailment conditions may be unknown at candidate location.
issues.mitigation: Require grid studies and utility commissioning timetable.

issues.title: Environmental and social safeguards
issues.reason: Land and water impacts can affect schedule and project consent.
issues.mitigation: Assess AMDAL/UKL-UPL and community process.

issues.title: Commercial rule stability
issues.reason: Renewable tariff and PPA terms vary with implementation rules.
issues.mitigation: Apply Permen ESDM 5/2025 clauses to signed PJBL.

issues.title: Digital metering / data controls
issues.reason: Operational data arrangements and smart-grid requirements may affect design.
issues.mitigation: Confirm telemetry and cyber duties.

issues.title: Financing and COD certainty
issues.reason: National RUPTL plans do not establish project financial close.
issues.mitigation: Check PJBL, guarantees, EPC/finance and COD milestones.

issues.title: Mining rights & processing permits
issues.reason: Latest mining-amendment framework and OSS/sectoral permissions must be read together.
issues.mitigation: Consolidate IUP/IUPK, RKAB and downstream permits by entity.

issues.title: Smelter grid dependency
issues.reason: Large power draw can depend on PLN or own generation.
issues.mitigation: Check grid agreement, captive power and fuel supply.

issues.title: Environmental and tailings impacts
issues.reason: Environmental management obligations can affect feasibility and public confidence.
issues.mitigation: Review AMDAL, water/tailings permits and monitoring.

issues.title: Post-2025 concession and license rules
issues.reason: UU 2/2025 and PP changes warrant contract-by-contract legal review.
issues.mitigation: Check transition and implementing rules for the project type.

issues.title: Compliance data and reporting
issues.reason: Digital reporting systems can have specific obligations.
issues.mitigation: Review e-RKAB and sector reporting channels.

issues.title: Export / downstream project execution
issues.reason: Processing milestones and market constraints may shift financial outcomes.
issues.mitigation: Confirm commissioning, feedstock and off-take terms.

issues.title: Upstream/downstream jurisdiction
issues.reason: SKK Migas upstream and downstream commercial regimes differ.
issues.mitigation: Identify PSC/working area, licensing entity and oversight chain.

issues.title: Fuel reliability
issues.reason: Gas allocation for electricity requires concrete contracted supply and transport.
issues.mitigation: Check gas nominations, pipelines and HGBT eligibility.

issues.title: Methane & site permits
issues.reason: Site emissions and environmental permits vary by installation.
issues.mitigation: Verify environmental approval, venting/flaring and monitoring.

issues.title: Contract and gas price framework
issues.reason: Operational contracts and administered gas-price decisions are source/recipient specific.
issues.mitigation: Check beneficiary schedule and most recent amended price decision.

issues.title: Cyber operational controls
issues.reason: Critical infrastructure may face operational cybersecurity threats.
issues.mitigation: Assess security and incident practices.

issues.title: Reservoir/production execution risk
issues.reason: Reserve and field maturity constrain delivery independently of licenses.
issues.mitigation: Require verified production and reserve data.

issues.title: Transport / storage authorization
issues.reason: Storage permissions differ from carbon-unit recognition and markets.
issues.mitigation: Map project-specific exploration, injection, storage and monitoring licenses.

issues.title: Energy penalty and supply
issues.reason: CCS equipment adds energy demand.
issues.mitigation: Calculate capture compression loads and supply contracts.

issues.title: Storage environmental monitoring
issues.reason: Containment, leakage and post-closure liability need verified plans.
issues.mitigation: Obtain environmental monitoring and long-term stewardship terms.

issues.title: Carbon MRV and attribute rules
issues.reason: Eligible units, registries, transfers and accounting depend on applicable newer instruments.
issues.mitigation: Validate against Perpres 110/2025 and operational implementing rules.

issues.title: Registry and data reliability
issues.reason: Audit trail integrity is needed for credible credits.
issues.mitigation: Require MRV records and independent verifier.

issues.title: Carbon-price and revenue certainty
issues.reason: Policy announcement alone does not create guaranteed carbon credit revenue.
issues.mitigation: Conservative revenue underwriting and contracted buyers.
